title: lmdb: no SAFETY comment on unsafe EnvOpenOptions::open
description: crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs line 218 — The only unsafe block is EnvOpenOptions::new().open(...). The comment above explains the invariant (single-open per process, enforced by OPEN_PATHS) but it is placed before the unsafe block, not as a '// SAFETY:' comment immediately preceding the unsafe keyword. Per project rules, every unsafe block in this crate must have a // SAFETY: comment explaining invariant uphold — missing this is a P0.
